verdict.rationale: HubSpot's first-party pages describe native custom dashboards, dozens of pre-built sales reports, custom analytics reports with filters and chart types, sales activity monitoring, and plain-language AI report building, so reporting happens inside the CRM rather than in a spreadsheet. The evidence is marketing-level, and pipeline and conversion reports are implied by 'sales reports' rather than named. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of pipeline and conversion-rate reports, in-depth knowledge-base docs on report building, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can build reports and dashboards on pipeline, activity, and conversion without exporting to a spreadsheet

citations.quote: Build custom reporting dashboards for every team
Choose from dozens of pre-built reports or customize your own
Build marketing, sales, revenue, and service analytics reports with filters and chart types to see exactly what's happening across your business
Monitor your team’s sales activities and unlock additional rep performance with deep coaching insights
with Breeze Assistant, describe the report you need in plain language, and HubSpot will build it from your actual data.
